title: Held-out QUEEN gold label (one JSON object per line of labels.jsonl)
description: Label from the raw text and the board, without opening predictions/. Label every concrete statement, so a miss can be seen. Policy: a claim a careful reader can resolve uniquely to an existing predicate is extractable, whatever the grammar can do. Extraction truth (what the text says) is separate from chess truth (whether it holds).

branch.description: UCI moves from the root to the board the claim is about; [] is the root; null if the line has already left legal play

board_fen.description: Optional. If given, must equal the replayed branch

chess_truth.description: UNDETERMINED: no board to judge on (branch null)

polarity.description: Whether the text asserts that the predicate holds or that it does not. chess_truth is the truth of the statement as written, polarity included.

false_concrete.description: The statement is concrete and false although no predicate represents it, or it cannot be resolved. Counts in the end-to-end denominator

moves.description: UCI from the root, up to and including the first illegal ply

annotations_hold.description: The line's stated captures, + and # are all true

failure_ply.description: Index in moves of the first failure
